result.description: GNOWANGERUP FAMILY SUPPORT ASSOC INC   The Opportunity   We are seeking a qualified and committed Child Care Worker (ANZSCO 421111) to join our team. The successful applicant will provide quality care and educational support to children while helping maintain a safe, welcoming and developmentally appropriate environment.   You will be required to:   Provide quality care and supervision to children across GFSA’s centre-based and mobile childcare programs. Support daily routines, learning and recreational activities while maintaining a safe, inclusive and nurturing environment for children throughout the regional communities we service.         Benefits  Benefits of Working with GFSA   Join a welcoming and supportive community-based team.  Make a meaningful difference to children and families in regional communities.  Enjoy a varied role across centre-based and mobile childcare programs.  Work in a friendly, inclusive and nurturing environment.  Access opportunities for professional development and career growth.  Experience the relaxed lifestyle and strong community spirit of regional Western Australia.    Task & responsibilities   Key Responsibilities    Provide attentive care and active supervision for children participating in the Association’s centre-based and mobile occasional-care programs.   Assist with preparing age-appropriate materials and equipment for children’s educational, play-based and recreational activities.   Prepare and conduct indoor and outdoor activities that support children’s physical, emotional, social and cognitive development.   Supervise children’s daily routines, including meals, rest periods, toileting, personal hygiene and transitions between activities.   Use positive behaviour-guidance strategies to support children’s social development, confidence and interactions with others.   Develop and implement a high quality education and care curriculum for all enrolled children that is consistent with: * The service philosophy and policies, * The National Quality Standards, * Educations and Care Services National Law, * Education and Care Services National Regulations, * Early Years Learning Framework    Observe children’s wellbeing, development and participation, and maintain accurate records in accordance with service procedures.   Establish respectful relationships with children and communicate appropriately with parents, carers, educators and other team members.   Maintain clean, safe and well-organised learning environments, including setting up and packing away equipment at centre and mobile-service locations.   Support the inclusion of children from diverse cultural backgrounds and children with additional needs.   Follow child-safety requirements, supervision ratios, hygiene procedures, workplace health and safety requirements and the Association’s policies.   Work with the team within the Service to develop, deliver and monitor quality curriculum consistent with the requirements of the National Quality Framework.   Assist with mobile service delivery across regional communities, including Gnowangerup, Borden, Ongerup, Nyabing and Newdegate, where required.    Qualification & experience   Essential    QF Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Care with at least two years of leadership position, or an AQF Certificate IV or higher relevant qualification.  Relevant experience providing care and supervision to children in a childcare setting.   Current Working with Children Check and approved First Aid, CPR, asthma and anaphylaxis training, or ability to obtain.   Current driver’s licence and willingness to travel to mobile childcare locations when required.      About Company     Gnowangerup Family Support Association Inc. is a not-for-profit, community-based organisation established in 1988. The Association provides accessible, affordable and high-quality early childhood education and care to children and families across Gnowangerup, Borden, Ongerup, Nyabing and Newdegate. Through its centre-based and mobile services, the organisation supports regional and remote families while creating safe, inclusive and nurturing environments where children can learn, develop and reach their full potential.       Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $75000-80000   Job Publish:  24-07-2026   Job Expire:  23-08-2026  Apply on:  Child Care Worker Job here!    This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.
